incident_spec.summary: ALTER TABLE operation caused blocking due to lock contention.
symptoms: Database froze during ALTER TABLE operation
Login system blocked due to table lock
incident_spec.mechanism: ALTER TABLE requires an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, which queued behind weaker locks held by idle transactions.

value.sql: ALTER TABLE cliente ADD COLUMN topicos character varying(20)[];

facts.evidence: Post describes the exact SQL command causing the issue.
Post mentions lock contention and PostgreSQL documentation confirms this lock type for ALTER TABLE.
Post suggests querying pg_locks and pg_stat_activity to identify idle transactions.

assumptions: The synthetic database will reproduce lock contention with similar table structure and workload.
Idle transactions can be simulated to mimic the blocking behavior.
unknowns: Exact workload characteristics of the production environment
Whether other operations were performed after the ADD COLUMN command

feasibility.rationale: Synthetic data and simulated idle transactions can reproduce the lock contention mechanism.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cliente (rut VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, nombre VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, razon_social VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, direccion VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, comuna VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ciudad VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, codigo_pais VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, activo BOOLEAN DEFAULT true, id SERIAL NOT NULL, stock BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, vigente BOOLEAN DEFAULT true, clase INTEGER DEFAULT 1, plan INTEGER DEFAULT 1, plantilla VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'WAYPOINT', facturable INTEGER DEFAULT 1, toolkit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, propietario INTEGER DEFAULT 0, creacion TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now(), codelco BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, familia INTEGER DEFAULT 0, enabled_machines BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_canbus BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_horometro BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_comap BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_frio BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_panico BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_puerta BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_rpm BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, enabled_supervisor INTEGER DEFAULT 0, demo BOOLEAN, interno BOOLEAN, mqtt_enable BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, CONSTRAINT pk_cliente PRIMARY KEY (rut));
generation_sql: INSERT INTO cliente (rut, nombre, razon_social, direccion, comuna, ciudad, codigo_pais, activo) SELECT md5(random()::text), md5(random()::text), md5(random()::text), md5(random()::text), md5(random()::text), md5(random()::text), 'CL', true FROM generate_series(1, {row_count});
